content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Plugins online

Stripe is a payment processor that offers a range of features, including recurring payments, subscriptions, and discounts. PayPal is a digital payment service that allows for instant transfers and online invoicing. Gumroad is an e-commerce platform that specializes in digital products, providing features like customizable storefronts and automated email marketing. Lemon Squeezy is a platform that offers e-commerce features, including sales tracking, customer management, and product inventory management. However, all of these options come with significant restrictions and limitations, especially for creators in countries where they are not available.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Stripe operates in 46 countries worldwide, but is unavailable in 149 countries, including many in Africa and Asia. PayPal is available in 200 markets, but can suspend accounts at any time, holding funds for up to 180 days without appeal. Gumroad and Lemon Squeezy also restrict access to certain countries, leaving digital sellers with limited options for selling plugins and other digital products online. This is where a sovereign digital commerce stack comes in, offering a permanent structural alternative to these platforms.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Payment speed and fees are critical considerations for digital sellers. Stripe offers fast payment processing, but charges 2.9% + 30¢ per transaction. PayPal charges 2.9% + 30¢ per transaction, plus a cross-border fee of 0.5% to 1% of the transaction amount. Gumroad and Lemon Squeezy also charge transaction fees, but with lower rates. However, a sovereign digital commerce stack like Edge Commerce Stack ($197) offers faster payment processing and lower fees, with a flat rate of 0.5% per transaction.
A sovereign digital commerce stack offers faster payment processing and lower fees than traditional e-commerce platforms.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Ownership and automation are also critical considerations for digital sellers. With a sovereign digital commerce stack, creators maintain full ownership of their products and data, with no dependence on third-party platforms. Automation is also seamless, with features like automatic order fulfillment and delivery to customers. This is in stark contrast to the limited ownership and automation options offered by Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, and Lemon Squeezy.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

Choosing the right digital commerce architecture depends on your specific needs and situation. If you're looking for fast payment processing and low fees, a sovereign digital commerce stack like Edge Commerce Stack ($197) may be the best option. If you're looking for customizable storefronts and automated email marketing, Gumroad may be the way to go. However, if you're in a country where these options are restricted, a sovereign digital commerce stack is the only viable alternative.
